task_definition.scientific_warning: Source-native AC50 concentration annotations given readout, direction, target annotation role and other recorded semantic context. Binding, inhibition, antagonism, activation, agonism and p21 induction are distinct annotations, not harmonized biological potencies, generic50%activation or EC50/IC50/Ki conversions. B/F is not a measured direction. Human is a target/system-organism annotation; assay host, donor and cell-line species remain not_reported. Exact PDK1/mitochondrial-pyruvate-DH-kinase1 annotation retains an unresolved biological identity conflict, never a PDPK1 remapping. p21 is the measured induction phenotype/marker; annotated HDAC is upstream inhibitor-family context, not direct p21 or HDAC binding. NR13 is unresolved: all78 retained with features, only77 core records train.75/77 come from one paper; its holdout leaves only2training groups, so no independent source generalization is established. Unseen target/readout/joint contexts must be flagged, and queries abstain outside the qualified source annotation support. Inner OOF selects the model; outer holdout evaluates only the outer-train model. Separate all77 refits have no independent score on their now-included records.
